about: P46A T2: 20 sentences written on 2026-10-12 for the verb-to-action gauge – every one names an action the hero should do on a button (shoot, fight, steal, dash, block). Written before any P46 change, never taken from the P45 panel, the P45 sealed set or test-200. Tune on these and the P45 panel only.

sentences.text: A rabbit steals carrots and runs from a fox
Amanita mushrooms fight against bulls, flee from them, and shoot them.
Racing car escaping and shooting enemies
racing car escapes police and shoots enemies
A knight runs through a castle and punches goblins
A raccoon grabs pizza slices while dodging trash trucks
A ninja dashes over rooftops and kicks robot guards
A turtle blocks falling rocks with its shell on a mountain road
A pirate jumps between ships and fights skeleton sailors
A cat burglar sneaks through a museum and steals diamonds
A spaceship races through an asteroid field shooting aliens
A boxer kangaroo hops across the outback punching snakes
A squirrel snatches acorns from crows in a windy forest
A motorbike dodges cars on a highway and blasts drones
A goalkeeper robot defends the city gate from flying meteors
A cowboy rides through the desert shooting bandits
A penguin slides on ice and slaps seals out of the way
A thief on a skateboard grabs gold coins and escapes the police
A samurai frog jumps over lily pads and slashes dragonflies
A bee shields its hive from wasps before the storm
